messages:
maria: Quick sync — draft Q1 GTM play for PLG-led growth ready. Need to lock sales targets, enablement assets, and the experiment slate. TL;DR: 3 experiments, 2 sales plays, onboarding kit by Feb 10.

raj: Field ask — focus EU mid-market cohort. Target ask is $600k ARR for Q1 with ~70% coming from Dedicated deals. Need clear playbook.

elaine: We can support launch: 2-week nurture, webinar, and a case study. Creative lead time ~7 business days after brief. Need assets by Feb 10 to hit webinar window.

tom: Product constraint: private deploy infra changes scheduled Feb 20-28. Any SKU/price changes before Mar are risky. Rollout freeze window incoming.

sophie: Enablement can do sales playbook + battlecards. If you give win themes and 3 customer quotes, we can ship basics in 5 days.

jen: PLG experiments proposal: 1) Trial quota bump for dev orgs (double free units), 2) In-console model-recommend prompt for new users, 3) Onboarding email drip + checklist. A/B test flow -> measure signup->paid conversion.

maria: If trial quota bump is greenlit we model +10–15% MQLs historically. Need to tie experiments to revenue targets, not vanity metrics.

raj: Clarify metric definitions pls — for targets do we mean MQL->Paid (30d) or Signup->Paid? Sales needs a single surfaceable KPI.

tom: Suggest two KPIs: KPI1 = Signup->Paid within 30d, KPI2 = Paid ARR from Dedicated trials (new logo). Both measure different funnels.

elaine: Creative angle: "Speed & cost predictability" webinar. Any customers willing to present? @sophie can you confirm?

sophie: Two potential speakers: FinServX (pilot) and EduLabs. I'll request permission this afternoon.

deploy-bot: Reminder — product roadmap freeze Feb 12 23:59 UTC.

maria: Ok concrete next steps: 1) finalize numerical targets by Fri; 2) enablement outline by Mon; 3) experiments spec doc by Tue. Who owns the experiments spec?

jen: I'll own the experiments spec and tracking plan. @tom can you confirm API/rollout constraints for the in-console prompt and quota change?

tom: I'll confirm technical constraints and any infra risk by EOD tomorrow.

raj: Sales asks — scripted demo flows and ROI calculator (spreadsheet + slide) for AE use. Will help close Dedicated deals.

elaine: Marketing can build the ROI calc if we get baseline usage and pricing inputs. @maria or @tom can you drop numbers in thread?

maria: Baseline numbers (quick): avg tokens/day per trial org = 50k, avg cost/unit = $0.00008, expected uplift when converting = 1.2x.

maria: ```
Q1_assumptions:
- avg_tokens_per_org: 50000
- cost_per_token: 0.00008
- expected_uplift_mult: 1.2
- assumed_conversion_lag_days: 30
```

elaine: :thumbsup: That helps. We'll mock ROI scenarios for Small / Mid / Large based on those inputs.

sophie: I'll follow up with customer contact permissions by EOD and share quotes for battlecards.

maria: Great. Owners summary: Targets = @raj, Enablement = @sophie + @elaine, Experiments spec = @jen, Tech signoff = @tom. I'll compile and send final doc on Thursday.

raj: Sounds good. If we get customer assets and ROI calc early, sales can start outreach the week after launch.

elaine: I'll slot webinar dates contingent on enablement deliverables.

maria: Thanks all — short async check-ins if anything slips.

elaine: :raised_hands:

jen: On it.

tom: Confirming tomorrow.

deploy-bot: Roadmap freeze reminder posted to #product-updates.
